1 The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.1✦ 2 They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land2 for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.34✦ 3 If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.5✦ 4 When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”6✦ 5 Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.78✦ 6 This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.1011✦ 7 So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.12✦ 8 Every daughter who possesses an inheritance13 in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.1415✦ 9 So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”16✦ 10 The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:1718✦ 11 for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.19✦ 12 They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.20✦ 13 These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

The Fifth Book of Moses

12✦1 These are the words3 which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.45678✦ 2 It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.9✦ 3 In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them,1011✦ 4 after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.1213 5 Beyond the Jordan, in the land14 of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying, 6 “Yahweh our God15 spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.16✦ 7 Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland17, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.18✦ 8 Behold, I have set the land19 before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”20✦ 9 I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.21✦ 10 Yahweh your God22 has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.232425✦ 11 May Yahweh, the God26 of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!27282930✦ 12 How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?31✦ 13 Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”32✦ 14 You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good33 to do.”34✦ 15 So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.35✦ 16 I comman36ded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.3738✦ 17 You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man39, for the judgment is God40’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”41✦ 18 I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.42 19 We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God43 commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.444546✦ 20 I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God47 gives to us.4849✦ 21 Behold, Yahweh your God50 has set the land51 before you. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.57 24 They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.58✦ 25 They took some of the fruit of the land59 in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good60 land which Yahweh our God61 gives to us.”6263 26 Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God64.6566 27 You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land67 of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.6869 28 Where are we going up? Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”7172✦ 29 Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.73 30 Yahweh your God74, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,7576 31 and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God77 carried you, as a man78 carries his son79, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”8081 32 Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God82,8384 33 who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.85✦ 34 Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,8687 35 “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good88 land89 which I swore to give to your fathers,90✦ 36 except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. You shall also buy water12 from them for money, that you may drink.’”13✦ 7 For Yahweh your God14 has blessed you in all the work of your hands. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,4041✦ 21 a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,4243✦ 22 as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.44 23 Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)4546474849✦ 24 “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.58✦ 28 You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water59 for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,60✦ 29 as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land61 which Yahweh our God62 gives us.”6364✦ 30 But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for Yahweh your God65 hardened his spirit6667 and made his heart68 obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.6970✦ 31 Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land71 before you. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.3✦ 2 Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land4, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”567✦ 3 So Yahweh our God8 also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.5253 22 You shall not fear54 them; for Yahweh your God55 himself fights for you.”565758 23 I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,5960 24 “Lord61 Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. 1✦1 Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.” 2 Yahweh our God2 made a covenant3 with us in Horeb.45✦ 3 Yahweh didn’t make this covenant6 with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.78 4 Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,910✦ 5 (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.43444546✦ 12 “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God47 commanded you.48495051✦ 13 You shall labor six days, and do all your work;52✦ 14 but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God53, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; 1✦1 You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land2 which Yahweh swore to your fathers.34 2 You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God5 has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart6, whether you would keep his commandments or not.789✦ 3 He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with man10na, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only1112, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.1314151617✦ 4 Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.1819✦ 5 You shall consider in your heart20 that as a man21 disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God22 disciplines you.232425✦ 6 You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God26, to walk in his ways, and to fear27 him.2829 7 For Yahweh your God30 brings you into a good31 land32, a land of brooks of water33, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;34353637✦ 8 a land38 of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; 1 These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which Yahweh, the God1 of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth2.34 2 You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.5✦ 3 You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.6✦ 4 You shall not do so to Yahweh your God7.89 5 But to the place which Yahweh your God10 shall choose11 out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.12131415✦ 6 You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.16✦ 7 There you shall eat before Yahweh your God17, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which Yahweh your God has blessed you.1819✦ 8 You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man20 whatever is right in his own eyes;21✦ 9 for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God22 gives you.2324✦ 10 But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land25 which Yahweh your God26 causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,2728✦ 11 then it shall happen that to the place which Yahweh your God29 shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to Yahweh.3031✦ 12 You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God32—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.3334✦ 13 Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;35✦ 14 but in the place which Yahweh chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.3637✦ 15 Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates38, after all the desire of your soul39, according to Yahweh your God40’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.414243✦ 16 Only you shall not eat the blood44. You shall pour it out on the earth45 like water46.47✦ 17 You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;48✦ 18 but you shall eat them before Yahweh your God49 in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in all that you put your hand to.5051✦ 19 Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.5253✦ 20 When Yahweh your God54 enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul55 desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.56 21 If the place which Yahweh your God57 shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahweh has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul58.59 22 Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike. 23 Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood60; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.61✦ 24 You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth62 like water63.✦ 25 You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.64✦ 26 Only your holy65 things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which Yahweh shall choose.6667✦ 27 You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood68, on Yahweh your God69’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on Yahweh your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.70 28 Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good71 and right in Yahweh your God72’s eyes.73✦ 29 When Yahweh your God74 cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land75,7677✦ 30 be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”78✦ 31 You shall not do so to Yahweh your God79; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.8081✦ 32 Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

13

12✦1 If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams3 arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,4✦ 2 and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”5✦ 3 you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God6 is testing you, to know whether you love7 Yahweh your God with all your heart8 and with all your soul9.1011✦ 4 You shall walk after Yahweh your God12, fear13 him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.141516✦ 5 That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God17, who brought you out of the land18 of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.1920 6 If your brother, the son of your mother21, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul22, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;23✦ 7 of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth24 even to the other end of the earth—25✦ 8 you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;26✦ 9 but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.27✦ 10 You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Yahweh your God28, who brought you out of the land29 of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.3031✦ 11 All Israel shall hear, and fear32, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.33✦ 12 If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God34 gives you to dwell there, that35 13 certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,3637✦ 14 then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you, 15 you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword. 16 You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to Yahweh your God38. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.39 17 Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy40, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,41 18 when you listen to Yahweh your God42’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

14

11 You are the children of Yahweh your God2. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.345✦ 2 For you are a holy6 people to Yahweh your God7, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession8, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth9.101112✦ 3 You shall not eat any abominable thing.13 4 These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,14✦ 5 the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.1516171819✦ 6 Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.20✦ 7 Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.21✦ 8 The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.22 9 These you may eat of all that are in the waters23: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.24✦ 10 You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.25✦ 11 Of all clean birds you may eat.26✦ 12 But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,27✦ 13 the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,2829✦ 14 every raven of any kind,30✦ 15 the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,31✦ 16 the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,32✦ 17 the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,33 18 the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.34 19 All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.35 20 Of all clean birds you may eat.36✦ 21 You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy37 people to Yahweh your God38. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk39.4041✦ 22 You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.42✦ 23 You shall eat before Yahweh your God43, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear44 Yahweh your God always.4546✦ 24 If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God47 shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,4849✦ 25 then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God50 shall choose.5152✦ 26 You shall trade the money for whatever your soul53 desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before Yahweh your God54, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.5556✦ 27 You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.57✦ 28 At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.58✦ 29 The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God59 may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

15

12✦1 At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts. 3✦ 2This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because Yahweh’s release has been proclaimed.45✦ 3 Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.6✦ 4 However there will be no poor with you (for Yahweh will surely bless you in the land7 which Yahweh your God8 gives you for an inheritance to possess)910 5 if only you diligently listen to Yahweh your God11’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.1213 6 For Yahweh your God14 will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.1516 7 If a poor man17, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land18 which Yahweh your God19 gives you, you shall not harden your heart20, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;212223✦ 8 but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.24✦ 9 Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart25, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin26 to you.2728✦ 10 You shall surely give, and your heart29 shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God30 will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.3132✦ 11 For the poor will never cease33 out of the land3435. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.3637✦ 12 If your brother, a Hebrew man38, or a Hebrew woman39, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.40✦ 13 When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty41.42✦ 14 You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God43 has blessed you, you shall give to him.4445✦ 15 You shall remember that you were a slave in the land46 of Egypt, and Yahweh your God47 redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.4849 16 It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,50✦ 17 then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.51✦ 18 It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God52 will bless you in all that you do.5354✦ 19 You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God55. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.56✦ 20 You shall eat it before Yahweh your God57 year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.58 21 If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God59.6061✦ 22 You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer. 23 Only you shall not eat its blood62. You shall pour it out on the ground63 like water64.

16

11 Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God2; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.345 2 You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God6, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.78✦ 3 You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction9 (for you came out of the land10 of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.11✦ 4 No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.12✦ 5 You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God13 gives you;1415✦ 6 but at the place which Yahweh your God16 shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.1718✦ 7 You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God19 chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.2021✦ 8 Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God22. You shall do no work.2324 9 You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.2526✦ 10 You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God27 with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.2829✦ 11 You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God30: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.313233✦ 12 You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.34✦ 13 You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.35✦ 14 You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.36✦ 15 You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God37 seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.38✦ 16 Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God39 in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty40.4142434445✦ 17 Every man46 shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God47’s blessing which he has given you.48✦ 18 You shall make judges and officers in all your gates49, which Yahweh your God50 gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.5152✦ 19 You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous53.54✦ 20 You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land55 which Yahweh your God56 gives you.5758✦ 21 You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God59’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.6061✦ 22 Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God62 hates.

17

12✦1 You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God3 an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.45✦ 2 If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God6 gives you, a man7 or woman8 who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant9,1011✦ 3 and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,1213✦ 4 and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,14✦ 5 then you shall bring out that man15 or that woman16 who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.1718✦ 6 At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.1920✦ 7 The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.21✦ 8 If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood22 and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God23 chooses.2425✦ 9 You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.26✦ 10 You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.2728✦ 11 According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.29✦ 12 The man30 who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God31, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.3233✦ 13 All the people shall hear and fear34, and do no more presumptuously.35✦ 14 When you have come to the land36 which Yahweh your God37 gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”3839✦ 15 you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God40 chooses as king41 over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.4243✦ 16 Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”4445✦ 17 He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart46 not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.47✦ 18 It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law48 in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.495051✦ 19 It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear52 Yahweh his God53, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;545556✦ 20 that his heart57 not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

18

1✦1 The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.23✦ 2 They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.45✦ 3 This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.6✦ 4 You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.78✦ 5 For Yahweh your God9 has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons forever.1011✦ 6 If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,1213 7 then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God14, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.1516 8 They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.17 9 When you have come into the land18 which Yahweh your God19 gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.202122✦ 10 There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,2324✦ 11 or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.2526✦ 12 For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God27 drives them out from before you.2829✦ 13 You shall be blameless with Yahweh your God30.3132✦ 14 For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God33 has not allowed you so to do.3435✦ 15 Yahweh your God36 will raise up to you a prophet37 from among you38, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.3940414243✦ 16 This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God44 in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”454647✦ 17 Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.4849✦ 18 I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.5051✦ 19 It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.52✦ 20 But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”53✦ 21 You may say in your heart54, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”5556✦ 22 When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

19

12✦1 When Yahweh your God3 cuts off the nations whose land4 Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,56 2 you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land7, which Yahweh your God8 gives you to possess.910✦ 3 You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land11 which Yahweh your God12 causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.1314✦ 4 This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—15 5 as when a man16 goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.17✦ 6 Otherwise, the avenger of blood18 might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart19 and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.20 7 Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.21 8 If Yahweh your God22 enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land23 which he promised to give to your fathers;2425 9 and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love26 Yahweh your God27, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.2829 10 This is so that innocent blood30 will not be shed in the middle of your land31 which Yahweh your God32 gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.3334 11 But if any man35 hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;36✦ 12 then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood37, that he may die.38✦ 13 Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood39 from Israel that it may go well with you.40✦ 14 You shall not remove your neighbor’s land41mark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God42 gives you to possess.434445✦ 15 One witness shall not rise up against a man46 for any iniquity, or for any sin47 that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.49✦ 16 If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man50 to testify against him of wrongdoing,51✦ 17 then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;5253✦ 18 and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,54✦ 19 then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.55✦ 20 Those who remain shall hear, and fear56, and will never again commit any such evil among you.57✦ 21 Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

20

1✦1 When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God2, who brought you up out of the land3 of Egypt, is with you.456✦ 2 It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,7✦ 3 and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;89✦ 4 for Yahweh your God10 is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”111213✦ 5 The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man14 is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.15✦ 6 What man16 is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.17✦ 7 What man18 is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”19✦ 8 The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man20 is there who is fearful and faint-heart21ed? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”22✦ 9 It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.23✦ 10 When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace24 to it25.26 11 It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace27 and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.28 12 If it will make no peace29 with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.30✦ 13 When Yahweh your God31 delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;3233 14 but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God34 has given you.3536✦ 15 Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.37 16 But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God38 gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;3940 17 but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God41 has commanded you;4243✦ 18 that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin44 against Yahweh your God45.4647✦ 19 When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man49, that it should be besieged by you?50✦ 20 Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

21

1✦1 If someone is found slain in the land2 which Yahweh your God3 gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,45✦ 2 then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.6✦ 3 It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man7 shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.8✦ 4 The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.910✦ 5 The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God11 has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.1213✦ 6 All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man14 shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.15✦ 7 They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood16, neither have our eyes seen it.17✦ 8 Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood18 among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.1920✦ 9 So you shall put away the innocent blood21 from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.2223✦ 10 When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God24 delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,2526✦ 11 and see among the captives a beautiful woman27, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,28 12 then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.29 13 She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.30✦ 14 It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.31✦ 15 If a man32 has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,33✦ 16 then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;34✦ 17 but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.3536✦ 18 If a man37 has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,38✦ 19 then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.39✦ 20 They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”4041✦ 21 All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear42.43✦ 22 If a man44 has committed a sin45 worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,46✦ 23 his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God4748. Don’t defile your land50 which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

22

123456✦1 You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.7✦ 2 If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.8✦ 3 So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.9✦ 4 You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.10✦ 5 A woman1112 shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God13.1415161718✦ 6 If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground19, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.20✦ 7 You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.21✦ 8 When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood23 on your house if anyone falls from there.242526✦ 9 You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.27✦ 10 You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.28✦ 11 You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.29✦ 12 You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners30 of your cloak with which you cover yourself.31✦ 13 If any man32 takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,33 14 accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman34, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”35 15 then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.36 16 The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man37 as his wife, and he hates her.38 17 Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.39 18 The elders of that city shall take the man40 and chastise him.41✦ 19 They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.42✦ 20 But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,43 21 then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.44 22 If a man45 is found lying with a woman46 married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.47 23 If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man48 finds her in the city, and lies with her,49✦ 24 then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man50, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.51✦ 25 But if the man52 finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;53✦ 26 but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin54 worthy of death; for as when a man55 rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;56✦ 27 for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.57✦ 28 If a man58 finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,5960✦ 29 then the man61 who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.62✦ 30 A man63 shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

23

11 He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.23✦ 2 A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.456✦ 3 An Ammonite or a Moabite7 shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,8910✦ 4 because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water11 on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.12✦ 5 Nevertheless Yahweh your God13 wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.141516✦ 6 You shall not seek their peace17 nor their prosperity all your days forever.18✦ 7 You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land19.20✦ 8 The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.2122✦ 9 When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.23✦ 10 If there is among you any man24 who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;25 11 but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water26. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.27 12 You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.28 13 You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;29 14 for Yahweh your God30 walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy31, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.3233✦ 15 You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.34✦ 16 He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.35 17 There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.3637 18 You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God38 for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.3940✦ 19 You shall not lend on interest to your brother41: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.42✦ 20 You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God43 may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land44 where you go in to possess it.4546✦ 21 When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God47, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin48 in you.4950✦ 22 But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin51 in you.52✦ 23 You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God53 as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.5455✦ 24 When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.✦ 25 When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

24

1✦1 When a man2 takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing3 in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.45✦ 2 When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man6’s wife.7✦ 3 If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;8✦ 4 her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to Yahweh. You shall not cause the land9 to sin10, which Yahweh your God11 gives you for an inheritance.1213✦ 5 When a man14 takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.15✦ 6 No man16 shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.17✦ 7 If a man18 is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.19✦ 8 Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.20✦ 9 Remember what Yahweh your God21 did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.22 10 When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.232425✦ 11 You shall stand outside, and the man26 to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.27✦ 12 If he is a poor man28, you shall not sleep with his pledge.29✦ 13 You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness30 to you before Yahweh your God31.3233✦ 14 You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land34 within your gates.3536✦ 15 In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart37 on it, lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin38 to you.3940✦ 16 The fathers shall not be put to death for the children41, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man42 shall be put to death for his own sin43.4445✦ 17 You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;46✦ 18 but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God47 redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.4849 19 When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God50 may bless you in all the work of your hands.5152✦ 20 When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.5354✦ 21 When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.55✦ 22 You shall remember that you were a slave in the land56 of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

25

1✦1 If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous2 and condemn the wicked.34✦ 2 It shall be, if the wicked man5 is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.6✦ 3 He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.7✦ 4 You shall not muzzle the ox89 when he treads out the grain.101112✦ 5 If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.13✦ 6 It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.14✦ 7 If the man15 doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”16✦ 8 Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”17 9 then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man18 who does not build up his brother’s house.”19✦ 10 His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”20✦ 11 When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,21 12 then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.22✦ 13 You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.23✦ 14 You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.24✦ 15 You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land25 which Yahweh your God26 gives you.2728✦ 16 For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God29.3031✦ 17 Remember what Amalek did to you32 by the way as you came out of Egypt,33 18 how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God34.35 19 Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God36 has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land37 which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

26

123✦1 It shall be, when you have come in to the land4 which Yahweh your God5 gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,67✦ 2 that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God8 gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.91011✦ 3 You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God12, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”1314✦ 4 The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God15’s altar.1617✦ 5 You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God18, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.202122✦ 6 The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.23✦ 7 Then we cried to Yahweh, the God24 of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.2526✦ 8 Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand27, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;282930✦ 9 and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land31, a land flowing with milk and honey.32✦ 10 Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God33, and worship before Yahweh your God.343536✦ 11 You shall rejoice in all the good37 which Yahweh your God38 has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.3940✦ 12 When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.41✦ 13 You shall say before Yahweh your God42, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.4344✦ 14 I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God45’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.4647✦ 15 Look down from your holy48 habitation, from heaven49, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land50 flowing with milk and honey.”51✦ 16 Today Yahweh your God52 commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart53 and with all your soul54.5556✦ 17 You have declared today that Yahweh is your God57, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.5859✦ 18 Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.6061✦ 19 He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy62 people to Yahweh your God63, as he has spoken.

27

12✦1 Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.3 2 It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land4 which Yahweh your God5 gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.67 3 You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land8 which Yahweh your God9 gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.1011 4 It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.1213 5 There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God14, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.1516✦ 6 You shall build Yahweh your God17’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.1819✦ 7 You shall sacrifice peace20 offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God21.2223 8 You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”24✦ 9 Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God25.2627 10 You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God28’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”2930 11 Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,31 12 “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.3233✦ 13 These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.34✦ 14 With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel35,36 15 ‘Cursed is the man37 who makes38 an engraved or molten image39, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’404142✦ 16 ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’4344✦ 17 ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’45✦ 18 ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’46 19 ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’47✦ 20 ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’48 21 ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’49 22 ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’50 23 ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’51 24 ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’52 25 ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’53 26 ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”

28

12✦1 It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God3’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations4 of the earth5.6789✦ 2 All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God10’s voice.111213✦ 3 You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.14✦ 4 You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground15, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.1617✦ 5 Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.18✦ 6 You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.1920✦ 7 Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.21222324✦ 8 Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God140 has given you.141142✦ 53 You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God143 has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.144145✦ 54 The man146 who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,147✦ 55 so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.148✦ 56 The tender and delicate woman149 among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground150 for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,151✦ 57 toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.152✦ 58 If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear153 this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,154155156✦ 59 then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.157158✦ 60 He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.159✦ 61 Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.160161✦ 62 You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God162’s voice.163164165✦ 63 It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good166, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.171172✦ 65 Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart173, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.174175✦ 66 Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.176177✦ 67 In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear178 of your heart179 which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.180181✦ 68 Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told to you that you would never see it again. Notes

↩ ⌘ Hebrew. D’varim (דְּבָרִים) — “words.” The Hebrew name of this book is its second word — eleh ha-d’varim, “these are the words.” The English title Deuteronomy follows the LXX Deuteronomion, “second law,” a translation of mishneh ha-torah ha-zot in 17:18 (which actually means “a copy of this law”). The Greek translators’ slight overreach gave the book its Western name. D’varim captures something essential: this is the book of Moses’ words — three long sermons delivered on the plains of Moab in the final weeks of his life.

↩ ⌘ Hebrew. ʼerets (אֶרֶץ). the earth (at large, or partitively a land).

↩ ⌘ Hebrew. ʼĕlôhîym (אֱלֹהִים). gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative.

↩ ⌘ Hebrew. ʼădônây (אֲדֹנָי). the Lord (used as a proper name of God only).

↩ ✦ Topic. Topics. This verse appears under: BLESSING.

↩ ◇ Note. The “canonical formula.” The prohibition against adding to or subtracting from God’s commands appears here, again at 12:32, and is echoed in Proverbs 30:6 and Revelation 22:18–19. Ancient Near Eastern treaty texts contain similar “tamper clauses.” In later Jewish and Christian tradition this verse becomes the textual anchor for arguments about the closure of the canon. Within the Pentateuch itself, however, the principle is more about preserving covenant fidelity than fixing a list of books.

↩ ◇ Note. The Decalogue, take two. The Ten Commandments appear here in their second canonical form (the first is Exod 20). Differences from Exodus: the Sabbath rationale is the Exodus from Egypt rather than the seven-day creation (5:15 vs. Exod 20:11); the wife and house are reordered in the coveting prohibition (5:21); minor word choices throughout. Jewish tradition resolves the divergence by saying both versions were spoken at Sinai simultaneously — “zakhor [remember] and shamor [observe] in a single utterance,” an idea now embedded in the Friday-night Sabbath hymn Lekha Dodi.

↩ ⌘ Hebrew. Sh’ma Yisra’el (שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל). The most famous verse in Judaism — recited twice daily in the morning and evening prayers, taught to children, said as the last words of the dying. Its translation is famously contested: “Yahweh our God, Yahweh is one” / “Yahweh is our God, Yahweh alone” / “Yahweh our God is one Yahweh.” Each is grammatically defensible; each carries a different theological emphasis (oneness vs. exclusivity vs. unity). Jesus quotes this verse as the first of the two greatest commandments (Mark 12:29).

↩ ◇ Ephrem the Syrian (365). Ephrem the Syrian Commentary on Deuteronomy (c. 365 AD)

On the Shema — 'Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord' (Deu 6:4) — Ephrem reads the confession as the canonical Old-Testament Trinitarian seed-form: the threefold name (Lord / our God / Lord) coupled with the affirmation of one (eḥad) holds together the unity and plurality that the New Testament will unfold. The Hebrew eḥad (compound unity, not yaḥid solitary singleness) opens the conceptual space for the later Nicene-Constantinopolitan confession of three persons of one substance. Tewahedo Trinitarian theology cites Deu 6:4 + the dominical 'baptize them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost' (Mt 28:19) as the canonical Old-Testament-to-New-Testament continuity: the same one Lord is the Holy Trinity.

↩ ⌂ Easton. Dictionary (Easton's). TRINITY a word not found in Scripture, but used to express the doctrine of the unity of God as subsisting in three distinct Persons. This word is derived from the Gr. trias, first used by Theophilus (A.D. 168-183), or from the Lat. trinitas, first used by Tertullian (A.D. 220), to express this doctrine. The propositions involved in the doctrine are these: 1. That God is one, and that there is but one God (Deuteronomy 6:4; 1 Kings 8:60; Isaiah 44:6; Mark 12:29, 32; John 10:30). 2. That the Father is a distinct divine Person (hypostasis, subsistentia, persona, suppositum intellectuale), distinct from the Son and the Holy Spirit. 3. That Jesus Christ was truly God, and yet was a Person distinct from the Father and the Holy Spirit. 4. That the Holy Spirit is also a distinct divine Person.

↩ ⌂ Easton. Dictionary (Easton's). ELECTION OF GRACE The Scripture speaks (1) of the election of individuals to office or to honour and privilege, e.g., Abraham, Jacob, Saul, David, Solomon, were all chosen by God for the positions they held; so also were the apostles. (2) There is also an election of nations to special privileges, e.g., the Hebrews (Deuteronomy 7:6; Romans 9:4). (3) But in addition there is an election of individuals to eternal life (2 Thessalonians 2:13; Ephesians 1:4; 1 Peter 1:2; John 13:18). The ground of this election to salvation is the good pleasure of God (Ephesians 1:5, 11; Matthew 11:25, 26; John 15:16, 19). God claims the right so to do (Romans 9:16, 21). It is not conditioned on faith or repentance, but is of soverign grace (Romans 11:4-6; Ephesians 1:3-6). All that pertain to salvation, the means (Ephesians 2:8; 2 Thessalonians 2:13) as well as the end, are of God (Acts 5:31; 2 Timothy 2:25; 1 Corinthians 1:30; Ephesians 2:5, 10). Faith and repentance and all other graces are the exercises of a regenerated soul; and regeneration is God’s work, a “new creature.” Men are elected “to salvation,” “to the adoption of sons,” “to be holy and without blame before him in love” (2 Thessalonians 2:13; Galatians 4:4, 5; Ephesians 1:4). The ultimate end of election is the praise of God’s grace (Ephesians 1:6, 12). (See PREDESTINATION.)

↩ ✦ Topic. Topics. This verse appears under: Character of Saints, Election, Jews, The, Jews, The, Jews, The.

↩ ◇ Note. Election by smallness. A foundational theological move: God’s choice of Israel is not based on Israel’s greatness but on God’s love and on the oath sworn to the patriarchs (7:8). The pattern recurs in the prophets (Amos 3:2: “you only have I known of all the families of the earth”) and is taken up by Paul in 1 Cor 1:27 — “God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise.” Election as gift rather than reward is one of the deeper through-lines of biblical theology.

↩ ◇ Note. The wilderness pedagogy. Manna as theological lesson: the dependence of the body on God’s sustained word, not merely on natural processes. Jesus quotes this verse to the tempter in the wilderness (Matt 4:4, Luke 4:4). The deeper context in Deut 8 is a meditation on prosperity’s spiritual danger — the warning that when the people enter a land of plenty, they will be tempted to forget the lean years that taught them dependence.
